|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Coruscant: Night Club (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-coruscantnightclub-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-coruscantnightclub022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/coruscantnightclub.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/coruscantnightclub.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Tatooine: Cantina (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your characters here are defense value -1 and may not be excluded from battle.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Coruscant: Night Club (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-coruscantnightclubab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/coruscantnightclub.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/coruscantnightclub.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Tatooine: Cantina (Light)” → “Tatooine: Cantina (Light)” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (487×347 → 1039×745 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Cantina (Light)”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your characters here are defense value -1 and may not be excluded from battle.”
